sources.title: SFU funding options for international students
facts_en: SFU lists separate undergraduate and graduate funding resources for international students.
Bursaries are supplemental, not guaranteed, and cannot be treated as core funding for immigration requirements.
facts_fr: SFU présente des ressources de financement distinctes pour les étudiants internationaux de premier cycle et des cycles supérieurs.
Les bourses fondées sur les besoins sont un complément non garanti; elles ne constituent pas le financement de base exigé pour l’immigration.
sources.preparation: Choose the undergraduate or graduate route and ask SFU Financial Aid and Awards about applicable support.
sources.limits: Institution-specific discovery only; admission does not imply financial support; no award amount or deadline verified.
sources.translation_status: French summaries are AI-drafted; human language review not performed

sources.title: SFU undergraduate bursaries
facts_en: SFU undergraduate bursaries depend on assessed financial need and enrolment requirements, with listed exceptions.
Check the current application period; applications use the SFU Student Information System. Bursary payments occur after the tuition deadline.
facts_fr: Les bourses de premier cycle de SFU dépendent des besoins financiers évalués et des conditions d’inscription, avec des exceptions publiées.
Vérifiez la période de demande; la demande passe par le système étudiant de SFU. Les versements ont lieu après l’échéance des frais de scolarité.
sources.preparation: Check the term and enrolment rules with SFU before planning on a bursary to pay tuition.
sources.limits: Undergraduate-specific page; eligibility is not inferred. Active dates and personalized funding not assessed.
sources.translation_status: French summaries are AI-drafted; human language review not performed

sources.title: UBC Vancouver financial support options
sources.section: Financial support options; If you have questions
facts_en: UBC Vancouver Enrolment Services Advisors can help discuss financial plans and funding resources.
The page separates domestic, international, Indigenous and disability-related resources; individual program conditions differ.
facts_fr: Les conseillers des services d’inscription de UBC Vancouver peuvent aider à discuter d’un plan financier et des ressources disponibles.
La page distingue plusieurs catégories de soutien; chaque programme possède ses propres conditions.
sources.preparation: Identify your campus and study level, then contact the appropriate UBC financial advising office.
sources.limits: This is the Vancouver campus site. Do not apply its specific programs to Okanagan without separate evidence.
sources.translation_status: French summaries are AI-drafted; human language review not performed

sources.title: UBC Vancouver emergency funding
facts_en: The published emergency-funding route covers registered degree-seeking students at UBC Vancouver and unexpected temporary shortfalls after other options are exhausted.
Tuition and student fees are excluded. Students may contact an Enrolment Services Advisor or use the linked application.
facts_fr: La voie publiée vise les étudiants inscrits à un programme menant à un diplôme à UBC Vancouver et certains manques temporaires imprévus après épuisement des autres options.
Les droits de scolarité et frais étudiants sont exclus. Il est possible de contacter un conseiller ou d’utiliser la demande liée.
sources.preparation: Describe the unexpected expense and ask an advisor whether this route fits; do not upload documents to VERA.
sources.limits: Vancouver only; degree and expense restrictions apply. No guarantee or amount is established.
sources.translation_status: French summaries are AI-drafted; human language review not performed

sources.title: Opening a bank account
sources.section: Before opening an account; Providing identification
facts_en: Compare how you will use the account, fees, interest and deposit protection; read the account agreement.
Banks verify identity using accepted original documents. Contact the institution to confirm the appropriate identification route and whether an in-person visit is needed.
facts_fr: Comparez l’usage prévu, les frais, les intérêts et la protection des dépôts; lisez la convention de compte.
Les banques vérifient l’identité à l’aide de documents originaux acceptés. Confirmez les pièces requises et la nécessité d’une visite auprès de l’institution.
sources.preparation: Prepare questions about accepted identification and all account charges; keep identity numbers out of VERA.
sources.limits: No account opening, bank ranking or individual acceptance guarantee. Financial institution requirements must be confirmed.
sources.translation_status: French summaries are AI-drafted; human language review not performed

sources.title: Opening a low-cost or no-cost bank account
sources.section: Comparing account options; Contacting the financial institution
facts_en: FCAC provides an account comparison tool for low-cost and no-cost options.
Compare total costs, including transaction and ATM fees, and confirm included services and any qualifying conditions with the institution.
facts_fr: L’ACFC fournit un outil de comparaison des comptes à frais modiques et sans frais.
Comparez tous les coûts, y compris les opérations et retraits, puis confirmez les services compris et les conditions auprès de l’institution.
sources.preparation: Use the official comparison resource and ask which no-cost categories, if any, apply to you.
sources.limits: No promotional product ranking; no automatic conclusion that a newcomer receives a free account. English and French page modification dates differ.
sources.translation_status: French summaries are AI-drafted; human language review not performed

sources.title: Newcomers to Canada and the CRA
sources.section: Residency status; Immigration status; Canada’s tax system
facts_en: Tax residency and immigration status are distinct; arrival date alone is not a complete tax-residency assessment.
CRA explains tax slips, supporting records, and benefit application routes for newcomers, including before a first tax return in applicable cases.
facts_fr: La résidence fiscale et le statut d’immigration sont distincts; la date d’arrivée seule ne permet pas une évaluation complète de la résidence fiscale.
L’ARC explique les feuillets, les pièces justificatives et les démarches de prestations des nouveaux arrivants, parfois avant la première déclaration.
sources.preparation: Read CRA residency guidance and prepare questions about income records and your circumstances for CRA or a qualified tax helper.
sources.limits: No residency decision, tax filing, liability calculation, or benefit eligibility determination.
sources.translation_status: French summaries are AI-drafted; human language review not performed

sources.title: Overview of child and family benefits
facts_en: CRA’s directory links Canada child benefit and other household benefits to their specific requirements.
Ongoing payments depend on current information and annual tax filing, including for a spouse or common-law partner where applicable.
facts_fr: Le répertoire de l’ARC relie l’Allocation canadienne pour enfants et d’autres prestations à leurs conditions propres.
La continuité des versements dépend de renseignements à jour et des déclarations annuelles, y compris celles du conjoint s’il y a lieu.
sources.preparation: Use the directory to identify applicable official pages, then ask CRA about unresolved conditions.
sources.limits: Directory is not an exhaustive VERA catalog or eligibility decision. Current page names Canada Groceries and Essentials Benefit, formerly GST/HST credit; do not promote the old name as current.
sources.translation_status: French summaries are AI-drafted; human language review not performed

sources.title: Canada child benefit — How to apply
sources.section: How to apply; Gather supporting documents
facts_en: A Canada child benefit application also lets CRA assess related provincial and territorial programs; separate applications for those related programs are not needed.
Check eligibility and situation-specific supporting documents before using an official application method.
facts_fr: La demande d’Allocation canadienne pour enfants permet aussi l’évaluation des programmes provinciaux et territoriaux connexes; une demande distincte n’est pas nécessaire pour ceux-ci.
Vérifiez les conditions et les pièces propres à votre situation avant de choisir une méthode officielle de demande.
sources.preparation: Prepare the questions and document categories shown on CRA’s instructions. Submit only through official CRA channels.
sources.limits: Do not decide who qualifies, infer custody or applicant identity, or collect documents/identifiers in VERA.
sources.translation_status: French summaries are AI-drafted; human language review not performed

sources.title: Province of British Columbia — BC family benefit
facts_en: CRA administers the BC family benefit as a program related to the Canada child benefit.
The BC family benefit is combined with CCB in one monthly payment; confirm individual conditions through CRA.
facts_fr: L’ARC administre la prestation familiale de la Colombie-Britannique comme programme connexe à l’Allocation canadienne pour enfants.
La prestation de la C.-B. est combinée à l’ACE en un versement mensuel; confirmez les conditions individuelles auprès de l’ARC.
sources.preparation: Read alongside the CCB application instructions to avoid duplicate application tasks.
sources.limits: No amount or award estimate; VERA does not assess household income or eligibility.
sources.translation_status: French summaries are AI-drafted; human language review not performed

sources.title: B.C. Newcomers’ Guide
facts_en: The official page lists the 2025 guide in English, French and Simplified Chinese, among other languages.
It introduces life in BC, including housing, health care, transport and other everyday topics.
facts_fr: La page officielle propose le guide de 2025 en anglais, en français et en chinois simplifié, entre autres langues.
Il présente la vie en C.-B., notamment le logement, les soins de santé et les transports.
sources.preparation: Use the page’s language-specific downloads for background orientation, then consult current program pages for conditions.
sources.limits: French PDF target is an official listed link but could not be fetched by web tool because of file size. PDF content and language-version equivalence not independently audited.
sources.translation_status: French summaries are AI-drafted; human language review not performed

sources.title: Welcome to Canada: Multilingual resources for newcomers
sources.section: Living in Canada — Money and finances
facts_en: IRCC links multilingual resources about arriving, housing, work, study and everyday life.
The money-and-finances section includes English and French PDF resources for orientation.
facts_fr: IRCC propose des ressources multilingues sur l’arrivée, le logement, le travail, les études et la vie quotidienne.
La section consacrée à l’argent et aux finances comprend des ressources PDF en anglais et en français.
sources.preparation: Offer the official language resource as optional background, preserving direct program sources for current rules.
sources.limits: General orientation; PDF contents and language equivalence not audited; not a current eligibility rule source.

sources.title: Financial Basics
sources.section: Money management lessons for life; Get started now
facts_en: FCAC’s Financial Basics covers budgeting, saving, credit, fraud prevention and financial planning.
The official page links downloadable learning materials and videos.
facts_fr: Les ressources de l’ACFC abordent le budget, l’épargne, le crédit, la prévention de la fraude et la planification financière.
La page officielle propose des documents d’apprentissage téléchargeables et des vidéos.
sources.preparation: Use the official resources to learn unfamiliar terms before comparing accounts or preparing questions.
sources.limits: Education only; no personalized investment or credit-product advice. Linked materials were not fully reviewed.
